entries.zh: 好；〔汉字与官话栏空缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: well, good (corresponding to Sp. bien); 〔damaged/incomplete entry, gloss tentative〕
entries.notes: 西栏残缺且汉字、官话栏皆[空]，仅闽南音 hō 可指'好'，故降低置信。

entries.en: it can be done; may, may one (Sp. bien se puede hacer)
it is permitted; that will do (Sp. bien puedes permitirlo)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:周/罔]，Bông 音近'罔/网'表容许义，释读依赖推断故降中置信。

entries.en: it would be unnecessary; one might well be excused (Sp. bien escusado estaria)
it is permitted; approved, allowed (Sp. bien puedes permitirlo)
well done; proper, fitting (Sp. bien hecho)
well ordered; serviceable, handy (Sp. bien mandado)
benefactor; one who has done good deeds (Sp. bien hechos)

entries.zh: 云开见月；久别重逢之欢迎语
entries.en: 'clouds part and the moon appears' — welcome after long absence (Sp. bien venido seas, después de larga ausencia)

entries.zh: 自创基业；白手起家之产业
entries.en: property acquired by one's own effort, not inherited (Sp. bien adquirida, no heredad)
public errand / official duty; bailiff's run (Sp. bilango, g. alguacil? garbled)
entries.notes: 西栏'algua cil'疑为 alguacil（差役）之残写，展开依赖推断故降中置信。

entries.en: 〔damaged entry;汉字与官话栏皆空，词义无法定夺〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏均[空]，仅存闽南音 xiam chū，无以定其义。

entries.en: crossbow bolt; quarrel (Sp. bisbo, g. saca? garbled)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:弩/努]，且西栏词形难解（saca），释读存疑。

entries.en: hat; head-covering (Sp. birafe, g. sombrero)
head-cloth; turban-like headwrap (Sp. binafe de manda ring, garbled)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:樸/僕]，pak-tāu 音合'朴头/幞头'包头巾之义，释读依赖推断。

entries.en: headcloth; kerchief worn on the head (Sp. birafe de sombrero)

entries.zh: 祖；祖先（西语 bisaguelo 疑为 bisabuelo，曾祖）
entries.en: ancestor, forefather; great-grandfather (Sp. bisaguelo, likely bisabuelo)
grandfather / great-grandfather; ancestor (Sp. bisaguelo)
grandfather (father's or mother's father) (Sp. bisaguelo bislo)
grandmother (Sp. bisaguela)
